run_reference_path_example: run the reference path follower agent navigating a habitat environment using geodesic or greedy mode
run_save_map: run the save_map function to concatenate RGB observations with a top-down map and instruction text
run_shortest_path_follower: run the ShortestPathFollower to get the next navigation action toward a target point in the simulation
run_images_to_video: run the images_to_video utility to render a list of frame images into a video file
run_append_text_to_image: run the append_text_to_image utility to overlay instruction text onto a rendered observation image
